Prioritization clarification (Phase 1, /dso:prioritize-epics):

This epic eliminates "spike" stories/tasks from sprint execution by absorbing all research and investigation work into brainstorming and planning instead. Any time the workflow encounters ambiguity that would otherwise produce a research/spike/investigate task, it must resolve it at planning time via an immediate research spike (e.g., gathering best practices from GitHub before authoring a new LLM prompt; building a database of values from web search; searching the codebase for all instances of a string), escalation to the user for clarification, or both. The presence of spike/research/investigate work during sprint is treated as a bug — evidence that ambiguity escaped the brainstorming and planning process, which is designed to eliminate it.
